caption: The drawing features a single teapot as the central object, depicted in a grayscale pencil or ink style. The teapot is positioned in profile and centered within a large square border. It has a domed lid with a pointed finial, a curved handle on the right, and a long, upward-curving spout on the left. The body of the teapot is wide and tapers toward a short pedestal base, which flares outward. The shading and line work create the appearance of a metallic texture. In the upper left and lower right corners outside of the main border, there are two smaller inset squares. The upper left square contains a geometric star or flower-like motif, and the lower right square contains a simplified line drawing of the teapot with dimensional notations. The background is a plain, lightly textured beige or off-white tone, possibly the color of the paper.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
